issues.legal_issue: An administrative determination of the beneficiary of an inam requires fresh consideration when relevant title records were not placed before the decision-maker and later challenges failed on a technical ground.
material_facts: The appellant, who served as an archaka, did not appear in the suo motu inquiry after receiving notice, and the authority granted the patta to the temple.
An inam title deed and register records identified the appellant’s ancestors as grantees, with the land burdened by service to the temple.

In earlier litigation involving the temple and the relevant endowment authority, a court found from the documentary evidence that the land had been granted to the appellant’s ancestors, not to the deity.
The appeal and writ challenge to the administrative decision were rejected on the technical ground that the appellant was not a person concerned because he had not appeared in the inquiry.
The appellant later brought a civil suit challenging the administrative order, and the Supreme Court considered that the relevant materials had not been presented to the original decision-maker.
issues.conclusion: The appeal was allowed and the matter was remitted to the inam authority for fresh disposal in accordance with law, with both parties permitted to produce oral and documentary evidence. The Court did not finally determine who was entitled to the patta.
issues.legal_principle: In the circumstances, the interests of justice required reconsideration by the original decision-maker in light of evidence that had not been placed before it. Section 3(2) of the applicable inam legislation was the basis for notice in the suo motu inquiry. The judgment cites no earlier cases as authority for the remand and makes no final ruling on title.

predicates.appeal_from_dismissal_of_challenge_to_ad: A party appealed after a court dismissed a challenge to an administrative decision concerning an inam.
predicates.decision_made_without_relevant_title_rec: The administrative decision-maker made its decision without receiving relevant title records because the affected party did not participate in the inquiry.
predicates.earlier_adjudication_supported_grantee_a: An earlier adjudication based on documentary evidence found that the land had been granted to the affected party’s ancestors rather than to the religious institution.
predicates.later_challenges_rejected_on_technical_g: Later challenges to the administrative decision were rejected on a procedural or standing-related technical ground.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a dismissed challenge to an administrative inam decision made without relevant title records, and an earlier adjudication supported the ancestral grantees while later challenges failed on a technical ground, the matter is remitted for fresh disposal on evidence.
